value.description: BDCDeratingMode: 0=Normal, unrestricted; 1=Standby or fault; 2=Maximum battery current limit (discharge); 3=Battery discharge enabled; 4=High bus discharge derating; 5=High temperature discharge derating; 6=System warning, no discharge; 16=Maximum charging current; 17=High temperature charging; 18=Final soft charge; 19=SOC setting limits; 20=Battery low temperature; 21=High bus voltage; 22=Battery SOC (charging); 23=Need to charge; 24=System warning, not charging. Values 7-15 and 25-29 are reserved.
value.rationale: The V1.24 vendor description defines the mode values; no live sample is required to establish the documented field identity.

value.encoding: u16 packed: upper byte mode, lower byte status
value.rationale: V1.24 explicitly assigns the upper byte to charge/discharge mode and the lower byte to standby/normal/fault/flash status.

I3170 is Growatt bdc1_ibat, the storage-device/BDC battery-current magnitude. HA-GII-4B found 66 charging and 77 discharging V4 records: BDC current was 0 negative / 3 zero / 63 positive during charge and 0 negative / 2 zero / 75 positive during discharge. I3217 remains the distinct directional BMS current.
value.live_observation: Growatt V4 bdc1_ibat: 143 classified records, no negative values in charge or discharge

value.rationale: The documented BMS status enum belongs to enum metadata; the textual value list is not an engineering unit. Existing decoded enum values are retained.
The retained HA-5 regression and live sample support signed BMS current at 0.01 A resolution; raw 0xFEB6 decodes to -3.30 A. This is distinct from storage-device current I3170.
